emphasis: Pyrrolysine is the 22nd genetically encoded amino acid and can be inserted at UAG in specific organisms; selenocysteine is the 21st at UGA

rationales.a: Selenocysteine is inserted at UGA, not UAA, via a specialized recoding mechanism.
rationales.c: Selenocysteine is conventionally called the 21st amino acid; pyrrolysine is the 22nd.
rationales.d: UAA is ochre, UAG amber, and UGA opal; the item swaps the UGA name.

emphasis: Apolipoprotein B48 is produced in intestine by C-to-U RNA editing that creates a premature stop codon in APOB mRNA

rationales.a: Alternative splicing removes introns or selects exons; ApoB48 production results from a nucleotide change in RNA.
rationales.c: The DNA sequence remains unchanged; editing modifies the transcript after transcription.
rationales.d: RNA interference silences transcripts through small RNAs but does not create the ApoB48 coding endpoint.
